prompts.name: library
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Library room background for a personal website, opaque 1536x1024 landscape PNG. The most recent Great Hall image is a STYLE AND ARCHITECTURE REFERENCE, not an edit target. Create an adjoining library in the SAME castle, with exactly its fine black-and-white stipple/engraved pen-and-ink texture, dense small dots, deep solid black shadow areas, white edge lighting and medieval stonework. Straight-on theatrical interior composition, shallow perspective, same scale of masonry and details. Tall stone ribbed vaults across the top; book-filled shelves recessed into stone arches at the left and right edges. Left side: worn tall wooden bookshelves and a slender leaning library ladder. Right side: a narrow pointed moonlit window at the outer edge, bookshelves and a small antique globe on a stand. Lower corners: several stacked folios, flagstone floor. A spacious quiet shadowed central bay, without a focal object: a white reading window will be placed by the website over the central 55% width starting 12% down. Put all distinguishing library objects in the outermost 22% on either side and architectural vaulting above, so they remain visible around that overlay. Still draw a complete natural room behind the eventual panel, not an empty rectangular hole. Match the reference's crisp stippling closely: no coarse pixel blocks, photographic realism, smooth gradients, colored tints or blurry shading. No people, no actual UI or white panel, no lettering/text/title, no frame, no watermark. This is ONLY the background room illustration. Keep bookcases legible at the far edges even when the middle is covered.
